profile.headline: React Developer || JS Spaghetti Professional
profile.summary: I am a software engineer bringing technical solutions in a fast and effective manner.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
• Design and ship serverless AWS backends: Lambda functions behind AppSync GraphQL APIs, DynamoDB, SQS, and S3.
• Own authentication and authorization in AWS Cognito and external identity providers.
• Work deep in insurance business logic: the rating engine, underwriting rules, policy endorsements, renewals, cancellations, and state-specific compliance.
• Troubleshoots and fix production issues end to end.

positions.title: Robotic Process Automation Engineer
positions.description:
• As a stand-in Scrum Master and lead programmer, created, led, and implemented a set of automation projects for a $5 million contract.
• Created complex, end to end automation solutions, working closely with Clients to ensure success,  involving learning Client software, designing architecture, development, testing and deployment of automation.
• Automated Web Based, Java Based, Mainframe, Desktop based applications using automation tools.

positions.title: Network Engineering Provisioner
positions.description:
• Interpreted network connectivity orders, specifications, and requirements to provide the best solution to the government and military needs for network connectivity and develop network topology.
• Coordinates between Network Engineers, government agencies, commercial ISP’s, and military personnel in order to provide network service.

positions.title: Network Engineering Provisioner
positions.description:
• Interpreted network connectivity orders, specifications, and requirements to provide the best solution to the government and military needs for network connectivity and develop network topology.
• Coordinates between Network Engineers, government agencies, commercial ISP’s, and military personnel in order to provide network service.

positions.title: Maintenance Technician
positions.description:
• Troubleshoots and repairs industrial manufacturing equipment malfunctions. 
• Installed customized equipment personally designed and produced using welding, fitting, cutting and fabrication skills.
• Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on equipment in a timely manner to facilitate production.
• Read PLC logic, schematics, CAD drawings, and equipment manuals.

positions.title: Aviation Electronics Technician
positions.description:
• As a Flight Line Supervisor, trained and supervised sailors in multiple qualifications to improve combat readiness.
• Troubleshot and repaired electronic and avionics equipment, components and systems including: RADAR, FLIR, and weapons systems with the assistance of schematics, CAD drawings, and equipment manuals.

positions.title: Billingual Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
• Performed customer problem solving and resolution in a variety of issues while maintaining awareness of proceedings, guidelines, and protocol.
• Successfully handled and diffused calls to ensure one call resolution.
• Communicated with management to report escalations.
